content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Postgraduate in any Social Science discipline with a minimum 55% marks, along with NET/M.Phil./PhD and at least two years of research experience. Experience: At least two years of research experience Desirable: Expertise in MS Office, Excel, SPSS, NVivo and research orientation with excellent research writing skills Published research papers in Scopus-indexed journals or other reputed research journals Background knowledge about the study area

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Duration 03 months, extendable depending on performance Position is purely temporary; services governed as per university and/or funding agency rules Selected candidates should be ready to join the project immediately

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Pondicherry University Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Send a copy of the Curriculum Vitae (CV) with a Letter of Interest for the post to [email protected] .
